testCase.name: [dev] S07 Each server-side PHI store is covered by the at-rest evidence

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S07 「服务端每个存 PHI 的地方都被静态加密证据覆盖」 Each server-side PHI store is covered by the at-rest evidence

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Convex at-rest encryption is confirmed active on the account through a settings check. At-rest encryption is confirmed active.（UAT OAT-02；TFA-92568 AC 4；TFA-92568 Eng 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given The at-rest evidence from S02, and the list of places that hold PHI on the server side: Convex tables (patients and residents, notes, transcripts, tasks, handoffs, aiCallLog, audit), Convex backups and snapshot exports, Convex function logs, every sink on the Convex deployment's Integrations page (log streams, excepti …

When Match each store to the evidence. Tim reads, on the UAT AWS account and region, whether Bedrock model-invocation logging is on and whether text data delivery is on, and opens the Convex deployment's Integrations page.

Then Every PHI-holding store is covered by confirmed at-rest encryption, backups included (OAT-04 'encrypted backups'). Bedrock text delivery is expected off (the infra comment: 'text delivery must remain off: prompts contain chart data'). …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U3. A PHI-holding store that the evidence does not cover = Fail; this includes the Bedrock log bucket when text delivery is on and any enabled Convex integration sink. Whether backups, logs and integration sinks are in scope is Q4.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 CONFIG · 配置核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：CONFIG · 配置核对；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
